annotations.title: Create booking request and payment link

description: Creates a booking request for a room option (room_key) and returns a secure Stripe payment link (payment_url) that the guest opens and pays. The card is only authorised; it is charged when the property confirms, usually within a few hours and at the latest 24 hours. If the property declines, the authorisation is released and nothing is charged.

room_key.description: room_key of the chosen room/rate option.

name: create_booking
